newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil March industry output down 2.1 pct-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil March industry output down 2.1 pct-IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian industrial production in March fell 2.1 percent from February, but was up 4.3 percent from March last year, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The IBGE said industrial production in March reached its lowest level since July 1996.
Industrial production in the first quarter of 1997 grew 4.6 percent, while in the last 12 months output rose 5.1 percent, the IBGE said.

Production in March decreased in 16 of the 20 industrial sectors covered by the IBGE survey, with the electrical materials and communications sector showing the largest fall at 7.3 percent, followed by textiles with a fall of 7.2 percent.
Output of capital goods, semi-durable goods, intermediate goods and durable consumer goods fell in March, the IBGE said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
